generator.title: Product Image Workflow
generator.description: Organize generation from product information instead of starting with a raw prompt. Choose the use case, category, scene, and selling points first, then generate the first result.

workflow.step1Description: Fill in the product name, description, and selling points to define the product first.
workflow.step2Description: Set parameters around real tasks like main images, scene images, or selling point visuals.
workflow.step3Description: Get the first generated result and the final composed prompt to validate the direction quickly.

form.title: Create a product generation task
form.description: Describe the product and selling points first, then choose scenes and export targets. The system will compose the final generation prompt for you.
form.productDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g., A lightweight large-capacity stainless steel thermos for commuting and outdoor use, highlighting premium metallic texture and a clean design
form.highlightsPlaceholder: Enter 2-4 selling points, separated by semicolons or line breaks

result.title: Result Preview
result.description: Currently showing the first generated image and the final prompt composed from this product task.
result.placeholder: After submitting the task, the first generated image, final prompt, and next-step asset directions will appear here.

preview.mainImageDescription: Validate product placement, composition, and platform readiness.
preview.sceneImageDescription: Next, you can generate more scene variants from the same product.
preview.sellingPointsDescription: Later, expand the same product into more detail-page and marketing visuals.

output.mainImageDescription: Continue refining platform, ratio, and visual style.
output.sceneImageDescription: Switch to more lifestyle scenes while keeping the same product context.
output.detailSetDescription: Turn the product description and selling points into more listing-ready visual assets.

newProduct.title: Upload the product first, then continue into the generation workflow
newProduct.description: Prepare the product image, category, and selling points before generating scene images, main images, or selling visuals.

form.title: Create a product draft
form.description: The first version connects upload and generation with a local draft, so the full flow works without a database.
form.imageHintDescription: Use a clear image with the full product visible. It will be carried into the workflow as the product reference preview.

form.highlightsPlaceholder: Enter 2-4 selling points, separated by semicolons or line breaks

preview.title: Product Draft Preview

tryOn.title: Clothing Try-On Image Generation
tryOn.description: Upload one or more clothing images, choose the model's gender, age group, skin tone, and body type, and quickly generate realistic clothing try-on visuals.

workflow.step1Description: Upload multiple clothing references at once. Prefer clear, flat-lay or front-facing clothing images.
workflow.step2Description: Choose the model's gender, age group, skin tone, and body type to tailor the try-on to your target audience.
workflow.step3Description: Get the first try-on result and the final composed prompt to validate the direction quickly.

form.title: Create a try-on task
form.description: Upload clothing images and set model attributes. The system composes the final prompt and outputs the try-on image.
form.imageHintTitle: Click to upload clothing images (multiple supported)
form.imageHintDescription: Up to {max} images. Use clear images with the full garment visible.
form.imageReadError: Failed to read the image. Please try again.
form.imageLimitError: You can upload at most {max} images
form.requiredError: Please upload at least one clothing image
form.promptPlaceholder: Add pose, background, or style notes, e.g., natural standing pose, solid background, studio e-commerce look

result.title: Result Preview
result.description: Currently showing the first try-on image and the final prompt composed from this task.
result.placeholder: After submitting the task, the try-on image and final prompt will appear here.
